note: GAM-012 The Number — one bounded statistic a day. STARTER SET = engine-demo neutral verifiable figures with sensible range bounds (so it's answerable, not a blind guess). The DATA-NATIVE questions (drawn from Claridas article findings, each with the true value + source + retrieval date + articleUrl, factual series only) are EDITORIAL/DATA (Onett) — same plumbing as GAM-011. These starters make the engine playable day one. Each item: prompt, answer (number), unit, min, max, optional step, context, source, retrieved, optional articleUrl.

items.prompt: How many member states belong to the United Nations?
items.context: South Sudan, admitted in 2011, was the most recent to join.

items.prompt: How many elements are on the periodic table?
items.context: The four newest were formally named in 2016.

items.prompt: How many bones are in the adult human body?
items.context: Infants are born with about 270; some fuse with age.

items.prompt: How many countries share a land border with Brazil?
items.context: Every South American country except Ecuador and Chile.

items.prompt: How many time zones does Russia officially span?
items.context: From Kaliningrad in the west to Kamchatka in the east.

items.prompt: How many keys are on a standard full-size piano?
items.context: 52 white and 36 black, spanning just over seven octaves.
